linkedin.title: Most news apps treat you like a demographic, not a person.
linkedin.body:
We often talk about algorithms as if they are magic. In reality, a recommendation engine is just a student that never stops paying attention. It does not guess what you like based on your age or location. It learns by observing what you actually engage with over time.

When you read a story about climate policy or a deep dive into tech regulations, the engine notes the specific topics you find valuable. It ignores the noise. It focuses on the signal. Over time, it builds a map of your interests that evolves as you do.

The goal is not to trap you in a filter bubble. The goal is to save you time. By filtering out the stories that do not matter to you, we can surface the ones that do. It is about respecting your time by only showing you the news that actually impacts your world.

Personalization is not about knowing everything about you. It is about understanding what you are curious about today.

instagram.title: AI Shifts: New Rules and Devices

slides.headline: AI Shifts: New Rules and Devices
slides.subtitle: From government crackdowns to new personal AI hardware, here is your tech update.

slides.headline: Trump considers new AI regulations
slides.explanation: The administration is looking at stricter controls on AI following recent hacking incidents involving OpenAI. This marks a significant shift for a government that has previously taken a hands-off approach to the technology.

slides.headline: Data centers face massive power fees
slides.explanation: Regulators may soon charge data centers hundreds of thousands of dollars per megawatt to secure power. This move aims to manage the strain that massive AI energy demands are placing on the power grid.

slides.headline: Meta is building personal AI agents
slides.explanation: Mark Zuckerberg confirmed that Meta is focusing on AI agents designed to handle tasks on your behalf. This signals a major push to make AI more proactive and useful in your daily digital life.

slides.headline: Microsoft launches its own AI models
slides.explanation: Microsoft is now pitching its homegrown AI models directly against partners like OpenAI and Anthropic. The company is signaling to investors that it wants to lead the market with its own technology.

slides.headline: OpenAI plans a family of AI devices
slides.explanation: OpenAI president Greg Brockman confirmed the company is developing a range of hardware devices for its chatbots. While details are still scarce, it suggests we will soon interact with AI outside of just our screens.

instagram.caption:
The AI landscape is moving fast this week, with major shifts in both government policy and hardware plans. Whether it is new regulations or new gadgets, the way we use technology is about to change. Which of these updates do you think will impact your daily life the most?

slides.headline: Tensions Rise in the Middle East

slides.headline: The Fight for the Strait of Hormuz
slides.explanation: Control over the narrow Strait of Hormuz has become a major focal point in the escalating conflict involving Iran. This waterway is essential for global trade and energy supplies.

slides.headline: Deadly Missile Strikes Hit Ukraine
slides.explanation: Russian missile attacks have killed at least six people in Kryvyi Rih and caused fires in Kyiv. This follows warnings from President Zelenskyy about a large scale offensive.

slides.headline: US Strikes Back Against Iran
slides.explanation: The US military launched heavy strikes on Iran after missiles were fired at American troops in the region. This marks a significant escalation in ongoing military tensions.

slides.headline: Samsung Hits Record Profits
slides.explanation: Samsung Electronics reported a record profit of 62 billion dollars thanks to the global AI boom. Their success highlights how much demand there is right now for advanced chips.

slides.headline: Saudi Arabia Targets Proxy Groups
slides.explanation: Saudi Arabia joined the US in striking Iran-backed militias in Iraq. The strikes were a response to attacks against US bases and Saudi energy infrastructure.
